title: Study of Blood Platelets in Sickle Cell Disease
brief_summary: We are studying if sickle cell disease blood platelets are larger than normal and how they may cause obstruction of blood vessels. We are also trying to study the reasons why large platelets are found in patients with sickle cell disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults and children \> 7 years of age with sickle cell disease (Hb SS) who are not taking hydroxyurea and are not receiving routine blood transfusion therapy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current hydroxyurea therapy or,
* Hydroxyurea use within the past 3 months
* Blood transfusion or exchange transfusion within the past 3 months
* Current treatment with aspirin or clopidogrel
study_population: Adults and children with sickle cell disease (Hb SS)
